## Working definition — TTW DERIVED

The award given to college football's most outstanding player, and the futures market on who wins it.

## Why it matters — TTW DERIVED

The guide treats it as a quarterback market with strong base rates rather than an open field, which is what makes it tractable.

## How bettors use it in this guide

From historical frequencies. Cohen states three: only five non-quarterbacks have won since 2000; three of the last four winners transferred in from another power programme; and the preseason favourite rarely wins — if CJ Carr or Arch Manning were to win it would be the first time since 2014. Contributors then look for long shots that fit the pattern, reaching down to 100-1.
